method: Actual source audit and personal inspection of all eight fixed exact-GLB final views; no exhaustive triangle-intersection solver claim.
observation: All eight exact final views inspected. Hero/reversehero/top show five edge-including seaward horns and four crescent bays on a continuous sand-to-swash surface. The shallow horn crests and bay swales survive the clay view, rather than being only color boundaries. Canonical front/side/rear are intentionally genuinely edge-on for this low-relief terrain and confirm a thin sloping tile; they are less informative than the elevated views. The regular repeated pattern is illustrative, not a measured DEM or process simulation. Water is the material region of the same connected surface, not a coplanar overlay. No dune domes, cliff band, foam or vegetation.
limitations: Closed meshes do not certify watertight Boolean unions, printability, all intersections, or independent acceptance.
